## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. A blocker of objectui#10519

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` and `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx` ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: under decision B on objectui#10519 (`5830213285`, 「readers first」), `PageView` stops remounting only once every block a stored page can hold re-reads in place. These two read once on mount with no data-invalidation reader, so after PR objectui#10777 removes the remount they would keep pre-action data. A blocker of objectui#10519 (p2) inherits its priority ⇒ **p2**, the same grade as objectui#10778.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T17:21Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), objectui#10519's body (`Blocked-by: #10778` only), objectui#10778, and PRs objectui#10809 and objectui#10777 (both open).

**Not folded into objectui#10778.** That card is in flight (PR objectui#10809), and in-flight cards are never folded. The files are disjoint: PR objectui#10809 touches `plugin-tree` and `plugin-dashboard`, so there is no serial constraint.

**objectui#10519's machine line.** Its body names only `Blocked-by: #10778`. So when that card closes, the unlock scan would release objectui#10519 while these two blocks are still stale. `Blocked-by: #10814` is added on objectui#10519 in this round.

**Execution notes** (the objectui#10623 / objectui#10778 shape):
1. Each effect takes the `useDataInvalidation` nonce for the object it queries (`dataChangeMatches`). For a dataset report, that is the object the dataset answer names, as in the `ObjectChart` dataset arm. ⛔ No second channel, and no remount.
2. `DrillDownDrawer`'s `drillDown.report` arm renders the same `spec-report` and gets the same reader in the same PR.
3. Pin each through the real `SchemaRenderer`: one read on mount, a second after `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` and one after its own object, and none after an unrelated object. A static block is the control.

- tests beside them; one `.changeset/10814-…md` (`patch` for each touched package).
⛔ Not `DashboardRenderer.tsx` / `DatasetWidget.tsx` (objectui#10815, this seat, in flight). ⛔ Not `ObjectDataTable.tsx` / `RecordDetailDrawer.tsx` (PR objectui#10819). ⛔ Not `PageView` (PR objectui#10777). Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12534` on objectstack `17bd3187`; `--tier` refuses objectui paths).

Serial constraints cleared: open-PR file lists read 2026-09-27T17:52Z at objectui `origin/main` `9a5f998` (15 open PRs): none touches these three files. PR objectui#10809 (objectui#10778, the reader shape reused here) merged as `8c3d7fc`. PR objectui#10777 (objectui#10519, seat 2) removes `PageView`'s remount in a disjoint file; this card is its blocker, so it lands first. No in-flight claim declares these files.

`Clause-②: no`: two read-on-mount blocks gain a data-invalidation reader. No declared key, export or accept set moves.
